messages:
anya: Quick follow-up thread for the auth+model-registry outage postmortem. We need owners, timelines, and a plan to avoid repeat in next quarter. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-auth-registry-outage
 dave: Short summary: vendor auth throttled token exchange; our registry single-region control-plane lost connectivity during cloud network instability. Two simultaneous hits caused fail-open to fail.
 selina: Adding vendor context: they enforced a burst quota we weren't aware of. I have vendor SRE on standby for a sync.
 kai: runtime mitigation idea: add a lightweight local manifest cache + ephemeral health-check that prefers local copy if auth errors spike. I'll prototype.
 infra-bot: Note: cloud provider reported maintenance impacting routing in us-west-2 during incident window.
 engleads: Need formal owners for follow-ups before EOD. Proposed list below.
 anya: please review owners/dates:
 - A1: Circuit breaker on token exchange + exponential backoff (owner: dave) due: 2026-04-05
 - A2: Local manifest cache + degraded model-pull path (owner: kai) due: 2026-03-31
 - A3: Registry regional replicas + read fallback (owner: selina/infra) due: 2026-04-12
 - A4: Vendor SLA review, request quota increase & burst handling (owner: selina) due: 2026-03-26
 - A5: Update runbooks + add auth-failure playbook with quick rollback (owner: anya) due: 2026-04-01
 - A6: Alert: auth-failure rate >0.5% for 10m -> open incident channel (owner: engleads) due: 2026-03-28
 selina: Created ticket QRT-912 and linked to postmortem. I'll include vendor meeting notes and current quota graphs.
 dave: For A1, I'll add telemetry to track failed exchange codes so we can tune breaker thresholds.
 kai: For A2, TTL suggestion 5m to keep staleness low, with a force-refresh flag for long-running sessions. Will include tests for session continuity.
 infra-bot: Reminder: infra change window required for cross-region replicas. Submit RFC to infra change board by 2026-03-29.
 engleads: Also flagging long-term: two similar incidents in 7 months. Recommend a recurring "dependency resilience" retro every 30 days to surface patterns.
 product-lead: Please add any customer-visible degradations to the comms plan. If cross-region fallback will cause higher latency, product needs to update SLO messaging.
 anya: I'll spin up the recurring calendar and rotate ownership: month 1 selina, month 2 dave, month 3 kai.
 selina: Vendor meeting scheduled Tue 2026-03-25. Will try to get written acknowledgement of quota increase or clear mitigation guidance.
 dave: small ask: put TASK IDs in PR descriptions so reviewers can correlate. I'll link QRT-912 in my PR.
 kai: :thumbsup: prototyping now.
 engleads: We'll add a dashboard tile for "registry auth fallback hits" to monitor trend.
 anya: After owners confirm, I'll update postmortem action table and close loop. React :thumbsup: to accept your assignment.
 dave: :thumbsup: accepted.
 selina: :thumbsup: accepted.
 kai: :thumbsup: accepted.
 infra-bot: QRT-912 updated: 6 open actions, infra RFC required.
 anya: Great. Next check-in scheduled 2026-03-30 09:00 UTC. Keep updates in QRT-912. If blocked, ping this thread.
 engleads: Also recommend a small decoupling experiment: allow model pulls to failover to a cheaper, cached mirror when auth is degraded. May need procurement sign-off.
 product-lead: Track potential billing/latency tradeoffs in the experiment doc.
 anya: closing thread for now. Summary will be posted to #all-hands once tasks are in the tracker.
